title: Protocol for Producing Human-Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell-Derived Cardiomyocytes
author: Knight, Cao, et al.

steps.title: Prepare fatty acid stock solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve palmitic acid crystals in 100 % ethanol to make a 250 mM solution and vortex until fully dissolved; similarly, dilute liquid oleic acid in 100 % ethanol to make a 500 mM solution. Store both stock solutions paraffin‑wrapped at –20 °C for up to three months.

steps.title: Make 10 % BSA solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 1–4 g fatty‑acid‑free BSA Fraction V into a 50 mL conical tube (max 40 mL total volume), add glucose‑free RPMI to achieve a 10 % (w/v) BSA solution (e.g., 10 mL RPMI + 1 g BSA), vortex vigorously until dissolved, then heat the tube in a 37 °C water bath for 15 min.

steps.title: Conjugate palmitic acid to BSA
steps.instruction: Add the 250 mM palmitic‑acid stock to the 10 % BSA solution at a 1:100 dilution (final 2.5 mM), adding slowly while agitating. Vortex vigorously; the mixture will appear cloudy. Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min, vortexing occasionally, until the solution clears.

steps.title: Conjugate oleic acid to BSA
steps.instruction: Add the 500 mM oleic‑acid stock to the BSA‑palmitic mixture at a 1:100 dilution (final 5 mM), vortex vigorously (solution becomes turgid). Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min with occasional vortexing until the solution clears, indicating successful conjugation.

steps.title: Prepare 50× galactose solution
steps.instruction: Weigh galactose and dissolve it in glucose‑free RPMI to a final concentration of 500 mM (e.g., 4.51 g galactose in 50 mL RPMI). Vortex vigorously until completely dissolved.

steps.title: Store stock solutions
steps.instruction: Both the 50× fatty‑acid solution and the 50× galactose solution may be aliquoted and stored at –20 °C for up to three months.

steps.title: Prepare maturation medium
steps.instruction: Thaw aliquots of 50× galactose solution, 50× fatty‑acid solution, and 50× B‑27™ supplement to room temperature (~22 °C). In a sterile hood, add each to glucose‑free RPMI at a 1:50 dilution (e.g., for 250 mL medium add 5 mL galactose solution, 5 mL fatty‑acid solution, and 5 mL B‑27 supplement to 235 mL RPMI) to achieve final concentrations of 10 mM galactose, 50 µM palmitic acid, and 100 µM oleic acid. Mix by repeated pipetting or stir bar until homogeneous, then filter the medium through a 0.22 µm filter into a sterilized container. Store the maturation medium at 4 °C for 2–3 weeks (aliquot if desired).
